label: fw.wad, the mod's textures, judged as one set: a concrete wall, a wet concrete floor, a steel grate with holes, a catwalk floor, a pipe-covered wall, a hazard-striped trim, a rusted steel plate, a control panel with dials, a sodium lamp's face (lit), the water, a sign reading PUMP 3, a door

halfLifeDetail.band: T5's band is least to most, Half-Life's own from the 5th to the 95th in 100: fine detail inside it is Valve's own range (a quartile is no bound); under least reads smeared or flat, over most noisy. A texture the brief asks to be one plain colour is flat in Valve's too (its BLACK and YELLOW are 0): flat is right there, and T5 is 2. A liquid (its name begins !) is held to Valve's own liquids instead, 0 to 20.1: the engine warps it as it draws it, and its water is smooth

T1.reason: The set reads as the brief's materials, but fw_panel (128x128) has three square lamps and a set of black slots, with no round dials, so the brief's control panel with dials is not there. fw_hazard reads as fine diagonal hatching more than as hazard stripes, and fw_wetfloor is a dull flat grey-green with no wet sheen.

T2.reason: Colours follow the brief's palette: grey concrete and steel, green-grey water and wetfloor, yellow hazard and sign, an orange lit lamp face, and brown-grey catwalk and rust. Nothing reads as neon or sci-fi. Judged by eye; no brief-colour measure is given.

T3.reason: fw_hazard (64x64, shown at three times) has stripes about 2 texture pixels apart, too fine to read as trim at a wall's scale; the pattern is closer to noise than to a stripe a wall of the game's would carry. Other tiles (catwalk plates, pipe flanges, rust plate rivets, grate cells of about 8 pixels) have believable spacing.

T4.reason: No seam is visible at the tile edges of any texture in the flat view. This is a visual read only: no step-across measure was given, so it is not confirmed by a number.

T5.reason: fw_hazard measures 101.7 fine detail against Half-Life's most of 75, and it is visibly noisy and moiré-like, so the set is not at least as good as the game's own. The other eleven measure inside the band (lamp 15.7, water 3.9 inside the liquid band of 0 to 20.1) and look sharp, so the fault sits in this one texture.

T6.reason: Names and kinds are kept: {fw_grate is 64x64 with holes that show as dark gaps, !fw_water is a liquid, ~fw_lamp is a lit face, the fw_sign face reads PUMP 3 in 128x64, and fw_door is a 64x128 door. Sizes are against the brief, not an original, so exactness to Valve's sizes cannot be checked from these measures.
